name: sol8-shell-visual-review
goal: Render distinct responsive shell previews and readable history, tables and navigation.

steps.title: Identify the failing behavior, expected behavior, and reproduction.
steps.evidence: Current committed captures reproduce empty viewer text, missing historical status, clipped schema cells and repeated registry notices.

steps.title: Explain why existing standardized tests missed the bug; name the scenario, fixture, lifecycle or assertion gap and reusable test change.
steps.evidence: Catalog presence assertions missed image identity and aspect, rendered status, schema cell bounds, empty usage and tab overflow. Extend the same captured states.

steps.title: Strengthen the existing standardized test; commit it before repair, run it failing with loop record --phase red, and preserve the assertion.
steps.evidence: 6e13454517fc8640e1cef9ffc33865d518b1fa7ecacd909648f2acd10c1efa9f: 28 visual failures and two passes at d04817ee08.

steps.title: Implement the smallest repair without weakening the regression test.
steps.evidence: 7f6e3362cf fixes screenshot captions and viewer mounting, historical status, phone schema rows, registry notices and tab scroll affordances.

steps.title: Rerun the same unchanged regression test at a separate fix commit with loop record --phase green; preserve passing proof.
steps.evidence: 669bea550e0493a96668a7704d81d3702b0b0af1eddae407ab15416f836582a1: unchanged command and complete test corpus, 30 passed at 7f6e3362cf.

steps.title: Run relevant project checks and affected UI browser flows with fresh inspected screenshots and no unexpected browser errors; preserve diagnostics and keep pending until proof passes.
